channel.title: Sahati Tech
channel.description: Sahati Tech is a cybersecurity awareness blog. Cybersecurity in plain language: explainers, tips and security rules.

item.title: How Facebook accounts get stolen: three common methods and how to shut them down
item.description: Most stolen accounts were never hacked in a technical sense. The owner handed over the key themselves, through a link or a code. Here are the three methods, each with the setting that blocks it.

item.title: A familiar voice asking for an urgent transfer: voice deepfakes
item.description: Cloning a voice takes just a few minutes of audio. Here are the signs that give away a fake call, and a family code word that protects you.

item.title: What does your photo know about you?
item.description: Every photo can carry your location, phone model and the time it was taken. When that data stays, when it's removed, and how to stop it at the source.

item.title: The 3-2-1 backup rule, made simple
item.description: Three copies, on two different types of storage, one of them off-site. The rule that turns ransomware into a mere nuisance.

item.title: Anatomy of a "Congratulations, you've won a prize!" message
item.description: We take a typical scam message apart line by line: where the urgency comes from, why the link is shortened, and what happens after you click.
